rows.name: Barclays
rows.appetite: Full-service; secured bias, centralised decisioning; payments franchise via Barclaycard
rows.risk: Adverse selection as challengers skim safest flow; Covid-scheme book run-off

rows.name: Lloyds (inc. Bank of Scotland)
rows.funding: Largest UK retail deposit base — cheapest float in market
rows.appetite: Largest SME franchise; conservative, secured, margin-harvesting
rows.risk: Pure UK-economy concentration; retrenchment cedes flow and data to rivals

rows.name: NatWest
rows.appetite: Historic #1 SME bank; cautious workout posture post-GRG; Mettle and Tyl as digital flankers
rows.risk: Conduct legacy constrains recovery tactics; ventures subscale against fintech rivals

rows.name: HSBC UK
rows.appetite: Trade and internationally minded SMEs; Kinetic at the small end
rows.risk: Appetite cyclicality — de-risks early and hard when group risk view turns

rows.name: Santander UK (+ TSB)
rows.appetite: Subscale in BB; retail and small-business scale play via TSB
rows.risk: Integration distraction; long-questioned commitment to UK SME credit

rows.name: Starling
rows.funding: SME and retail deposits — surplus liquidity
rows.appetite: Lending-light; BBLS-era book in run-off; mortgages via Fleet acquisition
rows.risk: BBLS guarantee eligibility — £28.2m FY25 provision after voluntarily removing guarantee; £29m FCA fin-crime fine

rows.name: Tide
rows.funding: E-money — client funds safeguarded at ClearBank, not deposits
rows.appetite: Payments and subscriptions first; credit mostly via partners
rows.risk: Not a UK bank; share is self-reported members over all 5.5m SMEs, not lending or deposit share

rows.name: Monzo Business
rows.appetite: Micro-SME accounts via retail-brand crossover; lending nascent
rows.risk: Unseasoned credit vintages; share figure ('1 in 7 SMEs') counts businesses, not value

rows.name: Zempler
rows.funding: SME deposits; profitable three consecutive years
rows.appetite: Micro-business accounts (~170k); credit embedded via iwoca
rows.risk: Thin margins at the micro end; dependent on partner credit appetite

rows.name: Allica
rows.appetite: Established SMEs (10–250 staff): commercial mortgages, asset, growth and bridging finance
rows.risk: 23% annual growth — unseasoned book; commercial-property collateral sensitivity

rows.name: OakNorth
rows.funding: Retail savings + deposits; sells ON Credit Intelligence software
rows.appetite: £250k–£100m property and trading-business credit; granular forward-looking monitoring
rows.risk: Low-default portfolio — 0.045% ten-year losses give no internal data for PD calibration; property concentration

rows.name: Shawbrook (+ ThinCats)
rows.appetite: Specialist secured; SME £4.4bn within £19.2bn total book; mid-market via ThinCats
rows.risk: Wholesale-market reliance; ThinCats integration and larger single-name exposures

rows.name: Aldermore
rows.appetite: Asset finance, invoice finance, commercial mortgages; GGS-accredited
rows.risk: Cyclical asset-finance exposure — losses track used-asset values and SME capex

rows.name: Paragon
rows.appetite: Buy-to-let heritage plus SME asset finance; GGS allocations; automated small-ticket decisioning
rows.risk: Property-cycle correlation across both sides of the book

rows.name: ThinCats
rows.appetite: Bespoke, larger-ticket funding for established mid-sized SMEs
rows.risk: Concentrated single-name exposures; adviser-led origination quality

rows.name: Funding Circle
rows.appetite: Unsecured SME term loans and working-capital lines
rows.risk: Marketplace-to-balance-sheet pivot brings credit risk home; unsecured book in a downturn

rows.name: iwoca
rows.appetite: Short-term unsecured working capital; embedded API distribution reaching ~3m businesses
rows.risk: High-PD segment; wholesale funding retrenches first in stress

rows.name: Wise Business
rows.appetite: No credit; cross-border payments and multi-currency accounts
rows.risk: Erodes incumbent FX and payments fee income that subsidises cheap SME credit

rows.name: Revolut Business
rows.funding: E-money/deposits; UK bank build-out in progress
rows.appetite: Payments-led (~0.8m businesses globally, +33% in 2025); credit ambitions nascent
rows.risk: Scale and speed versus controls maturity; UK credit entry would target transactional flow

rows.name: Square / SumUp
rows.funding: Group funding; advances held on own book
rows.appetite: Merchant cash advances repaid as a share of card takings — pure transactional-data lending
rows.risk: Losses track merchant revenue collapse in real time; concentrated in hospitality and retail
